([[New Haven, Michigan]]) | college = [[DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball|DePaul]] (2019–2021) | draft_year = 2021 | career_start = 2021 | years1 = [[2021–22 NBA G League season|2021]]–[[2022–23 NBA G League season|2023]] | team1 = [[Memphis Hustle]] | years2 = [[2023–24 NBA G League season|2023]]–present | team2 = [[Rip City Remix]] | highlights = * [[Big East Conference|Big East]] All-Freshman team ([[2019–20 Big East Conference men's basketball season|2020]]) * [[Mr. Basketball of Michigan]] (2019) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport|Men's [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry|the {{flagu|United States}}}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup|FIBA Under-17 World Cup]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2018 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup|2018 Argentina]]|[[United States men's national under-17 basketball team|Team]]}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Americas Under-16 Championship|FIBA Americas U16 Championship]]}} {{MedalGold|[[2017 FIBA Under-16 Americas Championship|2017 Argentina]]|[[United States men's national under-17 basketball team|Team]]}} }} '''Romeo Jajuan Weems''' (born June 9, 2001) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Rip City Remix]] of the [[NBA G League]]. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball|DePaul Blue Demons]]. ==Early life== Weems grew up in [[Detroit|Detroit, Michigan]] and attended New Haven High School in [[New Haven, Michigan]], where he was a four-year starter on the basketball team.{{cite web|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/high-school/2019/01/31/why-4-star-romeo-weems-didnt-go-prep-school/2726420002/|title=Why 4-star Romeo Weems didn't go to a prep school|work=[[Detroit Free Press]]|date=January 31, 2019|access-date=December 1, 2020}} As a freshman in 2015–16, he started in all 25 games and averaged 16 points, 10.7 rebounds, 5.1 assists, 4 steals and 1.8 blocks to help his team to a 22–3 record, a regional championship and the state Class B quarterfinals. As a sophomore in 2016–17, he started in all 28 games and averaged 18.1 points, 11.8 rebounds, 3.6 assists, 3.7 steals and 3.2 blocks to help his team to a 27–1 record, a second-straight regional title and a Class B state title. He averaged 23.5 points, 10.8 rebounds, 5.3 assists, 4.8 steals and 2 blocks per game and was named All-Michigan by [[USA Today]] in his junior season. As a senior, Weems averaged 27.9 points, 11.4 rebounds, 4.2 steals, 3.5 assists and 2.6 blocks per game and was named the [[Associated Press]] Division 2 Player of the Year and [[Mr. Basketball of Michigan]].{{cite web|url=https://www.macombdaily.com/sports/miprepzone/new-havens-romeo-weems-overjoyed-to-be-named-mr-basketball/article_852dbe24-4409-11e9-b3ac-f31e0b4389de.html|title=New Haven's Romeo Weems 'overjoyed' to be named Mr. Basketball|work=[[The Macomb Daily]]|date=March 11, 2019|access-date=December 1, 2020}} Weems finished his high school career with 2,151 points scored.{{cite web|url=https://www.mlive.com/highschoolsports/2019/03/mr-basketball-romeo-weems-adds-ap-division-2-player-of-year-honor.html|title=Mr. Basketball Romeo Weems adds AP Division 2 player of year honor|website=[[MLive.com]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|date=March 27, 2019|access-date=December 1, 2020}} Weems was considered to be a Top 50 recruit in his class and committed to playing college basketball for [[DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball|DePaul]] over offers from [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]], [[Michigan State Spartans men's basketball|Michigan State]], [[Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball|Ohio State]] and [[Oregon Ducks men's basketball|Oregon]].{{cite web|url=https://collegebasketball.nbcsports.com/2018/05/22/four-star-wing-romeo-weems-commits-to-depaul/|title=Four-star wing Romeo Weems commits to DePaul|first=Raphielle|last=Johnson|website=[[NBC Sports|NBCSports.com]]|date=May 22, 2018|access-date=December 1, 2020}} ==College career== As a freshman, Weems averaged 8 points, 1.7 assists, 4.9 rebounds and 1.3 steals per game and was named to the Big East Conference All-Freshman team.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/depaul/Article/DePauls-Romeo-Weems-ready-to-expand-his-game-as-a-sophomore-DePaul-Blue-Demons-basketball--154236171/|title=DePaul's Romeo Weems ready to expand his game as a sophomore|work=247 Sports|access-date=December 1, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/depaul/Article/DePauls-Romeo-Weems-Named-to-All-Big-East-Freshman-Team--144779906/|title=DePaul's Romeo Weems Named to All-Big East Freshman Team|work=247 Sports|access-date=December 1, 2020}} He was named the conference Freshman of the Week after a nine-point, five-rebound, three-block game in a 93–78 victory over [[Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball|Iowa]] on November 11, 2019, and scoring nine points with eight rebounds and four assists in a 75–54 win against [[Cornell Big Red men's basketball|Cornell]] on November 16, 2019.{{cite web|url=https://www.sbnation.com/college-basketball/2019/12/5/20996865/depaul-basketball-ncaa-tournament-rankings-texas-tech-2020|title=DePaul basketball's dream resurgence is finally real|work=[[SB Nation]]|date=5 December 2019 |access-date=December 1, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://fr.reuters.com/article/idUSMTZXEFBG2VR2WP|title=Reed propels DePaul past Cornell|website=[[Reuters]]|date=November 16, 2019|access-date=December 1, 2020}}{{dead link|date=July 2021|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}} Weems repeated as Freshman of the Week after scoring 17 points, 11 rebounds, three steals and two assists in a 72–67 win over [[Boston College Eagles men's basketball|Boston College]].{{cite web|url=https://www.detroitnews.com/story/sports/college/2020/01/12/new-havens-romeo-weems-helping-lead-depaul-resurgence-chicago/4420889002/|title=New Haven's Romeo Weems helping to lead DePaul resurgence in Chicago|work=[[The Detroit News]]|date=January 12, 2020|access-date=December 1, 2020}} As a sophomore, Weems averaged 7.3 points and 5 rebounds per game. On April 7, 2021, he declared for the [[2021 NBA draft]], forgoing his remaining college eligibility.{{cite news |last1=Kreymer |first1=Lawrence |title=Romeo Weems declares for 2021 NBA Draft |url=https://depauliaonline.com/53329/sports/romeo-weems-declares-for-2021-nba-draft/ |access-date=August 3, 2021 |work=The DePaulia |date=April 11, 2021}} ==Professional career== ===Memphis Hustle (2021–2023)=== After going undrafted in the [[2021 NBA draft]], Weems joined the [[Memphis Grizzlies]] for the [[2021 NBA Summer League]]{{cite web|title=Memphis Grizzlies announce 2021 Salt Lake City Summer League roster|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/memphis-grizzlies-announce-2021-salt-lake-city-summer-league-roster-210802|website=NBA.com|date=August 2, 2021|access-date=October 8, 2021}} and on October 8, he signed with the Grizzlies.{{cite web|title=Memphis Grizzlies sign Romeo Weems|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/memphis-grizzlies-sign-romeo-weems-211008#|website=NBA.com|date=October 8, 2021|access-date=October 8, 2021}} However, he was waived on October 15.{{cite web|title=Memphis Grizzlies sign Ahmad Caver and Matthew Hurt|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/memphis-grizzlies-sign-ahmad-caver-and-matthew-hurt-211014#|website=NBA.com|date=October 14, 2021|access-date=October 15, 2021}} On October 23, he signed with the [[Memphis Hustle]] as an affiliate player.{{cite web|first=Corey|last=Moore|title=Memphis Hustle announce 2021-22 training camp roster|url=https://memphis.gleague.nba.com/news/memphis-hustle-announce-2021-22-training-camp-roster-211023/|website=NBA.com|date=October 23, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2021}} ===Rip City Remix (2023–present)=== On June 8, 2023, Weems was selected by the [[Rip City Remix]] in the 2023–24 NBA G League Expansion Draft{{cite tweet|author=NBA G League|title=🚨BREAKING 🚨 The new @trailblazers NBA G League team selected 14 unprotected Returning Players in the 2023-24 Expansion Draft. Portland will retain the League rights to these selected players for two seasons, beginning with the 2023-24 season.|number=1666926025895280642|user=nbagleague|date=June 8, 2023|access-date=June 8, 2023}} and on October 30, he officially joined the team.{{cite tweet|first=Casey|last=Holdahl|title=The @ripcityremix begin training camp for their {{as written|ina|gural [sic]}} season today at the @trailblazers practice facility. Here's who they're taking into camp...|number=1719017456981696590|user=CHold|date=October 30, 2023|access-date=November 12, 2023}} ==National team career== Weems played for [[United States men's national basketball team|United States National Team]] as they won the [[2017 FIBA Under-16 Americas Championship]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/depaul/Article/Romeo-Weems-Brings-Home-Gold-119667230/|title=Romeo Weems Brings Home Gold|work=247 Sports|access-date=December 1, 2020}} He was a starter for Team USA and averaged 8.6 points and 8.1 rebounds per game when they won the 2018 FIBA U17 World Cup.{{cite web|url=https://www.freep.com/story/sports/high-school/2018/11/13/romeo-weems-new-haven-basketball/1992335002/|title=New Haven's Romeo Weems to-do list: Mr. Basketball, way more|work=[[Detroit Free
